mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% over three months indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.5pp over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >2% monthly, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability and economic confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 1.0% over one month signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% in prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 2.0% annualized indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when GDPC1 growth >2.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market weakening that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises >0.2pp monthly, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 over one month signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 in prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.
